one_line: The visionary physicist-engineer who led India’s early atomic energy and research institutions in the mid-20th century.

appearance.age_look: Mid-40s, slim to medium build, upright and poised posture
appearance.face: Oval face, fair-to-wheatish Parsi complexion, sharp nose, fine arched brows, intense almond-shaped eyes, neatly trimmed moustache, default expression calm and analytical with a slight confident half-smile
appearance.hair: Short, straight black hair with a precise side part on the left, combed back smoothly with a slight sheen; no headwear
appearance.costume: Well-tailored mid-1950s to early-1960s Nehru suit: a charcoal grey, high-collared bandhgala jacket reaching mid-thigh with four visible buttons and straight shoulder line, worn over off-white cotton shirt largely hidden by the collar; matching charcoal grey straight-cut trousers with a crisp crease; simple black leather Oxford shoes; a fine steel wristwatch on the left hand; subtle pocket seam on the left chest without pocket square, overall look minimal and refined, echoing elite Bombay and New Delhi formal attire of the era.
appearance.signature: A rolled-up large blueprint tube held in his right hand, labelled only by technical diagram lines, symbolizing atomic energy plant and institutional planning work, with a slim fountain pen clipped in his jacket’s inner seam often visible when the jacket folds.

ref_desc: Homi Jehangir Bhabha is a mid-40s slim man with an oval Parsi face, short side-parted black hair, charcoal grey Nehru suit and trousers, black Oxfords, steel wristwatch, and a rolled blueprint tube, in a palette of charcoal grey, off-white, black and deep blue.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Homi Jehangir Bhabha: a mid-40s slim man with an oval Parsi face, fair-to-wheatish complexion, sharp nose, fine arched brows and intense almond eyes, wearing a neatly trimmed moustache and short straight black hair with a precise side part on the left, combed back smoothly. He is dressed in a historically accurate mid-20th-century Indian formal Nehru suit: a charcoal grey high-collared bandhgala jacket that reaches mid-thigh, with four visible buttons, straight structured shoulders and a clean left chest seam, over an off-white cotton shirt mostly hidden by the closed collar, and matching charcoal grey straight-cut trousers with a crisp crease. On his feet are simple black leather Oxford shoes, and on his left wrist a slim steel wristwatch. In his right hand he firmly holds a large rolled blueprint tube covered in technical diagram lines, while a slim fountain pen is glimpsed at the inner jacket seam when the fabric folds. Use a restrained palette of charcoal grey, off-white, black, steel silver and a touch of deep blue to suggest academic and institutional seriousness, showing him front, three-quarter and back views with consistent face, hair, costume and blueprint prop.
